conventions.psi: Wb/rad; grid order [Z,R], consistent with existing FrozenField implementation; no sign/amplitude normalization applied.
conventions.TF: magnetics_bcoil interpolated at efit_times on magnetics_time, treated as kA as in unchanged FrozenField; Bphi=2e-7*144*I_kA*1000/R.
conventions.coil_metadata: fusion_coil_units=kA.turn/v1 is present in both original and new files. This does not replace bcoil-specific existing convention.
conventions.Ip: magnetics_plasma_current is not used by load_case or heat model; raw interpolations shown only to document known source timestamp erratum, without modifying raw arrays.

source_identity_limit: Public source IDs are anonymized filename identifiers. Files contain source=DIII-D but no numeric shot ID field. Distinct files and flux arrays support unused public records; cannot independently establish true numeric discharge IDs.
scope: No heat evaluation. All writes limited to study audit artifacts. Exact staged-file SHA256 equality proves every byte/array remains unchanged despite the legacy staged filename.

original_hf_revision_identity.interpretation: Compare field arrays, not parquet bytes: source file packaging/content can differ by release. See exact frame comparisons.
